flips: UT-01 (Salt Lake City & West Valley City)

summaries.senate: Polymarket odds for Democrats winning control of the Senate rose sharply, with the party favoured to take the chamber. Two races drove much of the shift: in [[Mississippi]], the Democrat Scott Colom made a sharp gain and is now a predicted flip, and in [[Iowa]], the Democrat Josh Turek also rose sharply, another predicted flip. The projected seat count is now 54-46, down from 55-45, and Democrats still gain control.
summaries.governor: Polymarket odds for [[Texas]] moved sharply toward the Democrat Gina Hinojosa, and the market now shows a predicted flip there. [[Nevada]] saw a similar sharp move, with the Democrat Aaron Ford gaining ground and also marked as a predicted flip. In [[Kansas]], the Democrat Cindy Holscher also gained ground sharply.
summaries.house: Polymarket odds for a Democratic House majority rose by a sizable amount, leaving Democrats the favoured party for control. The Democratic candidates also gained sharply in [[NC-14 (Gastonia & Huntersville)]], where Lakesha Womack is up against the Republican Tim Moore, and in [[IN-05 (Fishers & Carmel)]], where J. D. Ford faces the Republican Victoria Spartz; the market shows both as predicted flips.
